snippet.title: Drop Duchy - Official The Tribe DLC Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Check out The Tribe DLC reveal trailer from Drop Duchy where players will take command of the new Tribe faction, which introduces new exclusive building types inspired by real-life stone monuments such as Stonehenge. Align with the rhythms of nature and the stars above, drawing from the celestial magic of the Constellations mechanic to awaken new mystical abilities. Witness the ancient power of stone with The Tribe faction as they shape the battlefield with nature’s might. The Tribe DLC releases August 18 on PC (Steam).
